subtitle: We work with three distinct partner archetypes, each with a custom program designed around how they sell, build, or deliver.

cards.title: Solution Providers
cards.description: You advise and resell technology to your enterprise and mid-market clients. Adding WHITEGUARD to your portfolio means offering the region's most trusted cybersecurity suite — and earning protected margins on every deal.

cards.title: Tech Partners
cards.description: You build software, platforms, or technology products. WHITEGUARD's open API and integration layer makes it easy to embed security capabilities into your product — and co-sell to our shared customer base.

cards.title: MSPs & MSSPs
cards.description: You manage security for your clients on an ongoing basis. WHITEGUARD's multi-tenant platform, white-label reporting, and 24/7 SOC integration make us the ideal engine for your managed security services.
